verdict: 2% risk with 5 slots (Sdab570f4): 16.0% / −26.2%, against 15.9% / −24.2% for S44984096. About the same return with a deeper drawdown: no improvement. With the 20% entry cap most 2% positions are capped anyway, so doubling the risk does not double the bets.

7 slots beat 5 and 10 at every risk level. 1% / 7 slots (Se8a1c516) 16.6% / −23.5%; 1.5% / 7 slots (Se4840bfe) 18.1% / −23.7%, the best CAGR/DD in the grid (0.76). With 10 slots, 1.5% and 2% risk deepen the drawdown (−26% to −32%) and the worst year (−22% to −23%). These are single paths: a random-pick check is needed before trusting a 1–2 point edge.

Idle-cash interest is essential: without the liquid fund (S7b03d65f) CAGR falls from 15.9% to 12.4% and the drawdown deepens to −26%. About 3.5 points a year come from parking idle cash; in practice you must keep it in a liquid fund or liquid ETF.
Zerodha costs add about 1.9 points (Sc8f6dfe7: 17.8% / −23.9%). Zero delivery brokerage matters for a system with ~15 round trips a year and many small losses. This is a real, not fitted, gain.

Liquidity floor: the edge sits partly in smaller stocks. Only stocks trading ₹5 crore+ a day: 10.8%; ₹10 crore+: 8.4%. The floor is nominal (not inflation-scaled), so before about 2010 it removes most mid caps and the 2010–14 period collapses (27.6% → 5.0%). For a ₹10–20 lakh account (positions of ₹1–2 lakh) liquidity is not a constraint, but it means results would shrink for a much larger account.

Supertrend settings: (14, 3) (Sa1f19d11) 18.3% / −22.6%, the best CAGR/DD in the study (0.81); (10, 2) 16.3% / −22.1% with more trades; (10, 4) 15.8% / −30.0%, worse. Looser trailing (multiplier 4) hurts; a longer ATR period helps. One neighbour testing better is a hint, not proof.
Ranking same-day signals by 6-month relative strength (Sd7cc0575): 15.6% / −26.4%, no better than tightest stop; consistent with the random-pick check.

Next step, not done here: combine only the robust changes (Zerodha costs; liquid fund kept), and test the promising ones (7 slots at 1–1.5% risk; Supertrend 14, 3) with the 200-run random-pick check and neighbouring settings before adopting any of them. Stacking every best result would overfit.
